title: Site Migration
description: Post-migration verification after moving a WordPress site to a new host or domain.

steps.title: Verify Site & Home URLs
steps.instructions: Confirm WordPress Address and Site Address in Settings → General match the live HTTPS domain.

steps.title: Run Serialized URL Search-Replace
steps.instructions: Use a serialized-safe tool (WP-CLI search-replace, Better Search Replace, or host migration tool) to replace old domain references in the database.

steps.title: Flush Permalinks
steps.instructions: Visit Settings → Permalinks and click Save to regenerate rewrite rules after the domain change.

steps.title: Verify SSL & Mixed Content
steps.instructions: Load homepage, a blog post, and checkout/contact pages over HTTPS. Fix any mixed-content warnings in assets or embeds.

steps.title: Verify Cron & Scheduled Tasks
steps.instructions: Confirm wp-cron or system cron is firing. Check scheduled posts, backup jobs, and WooCommerce Action Scheduler queues.

steps.title: Test Transactional Email
steps.instructions: Send test emails from contact forms, password reset, and WooCommerce order notifications. Confirm SPF/DKIM if using custom SMTP.

steps.title: Configure 301 Redirects
steps.instructions: Map changed URLs and old domain paths to new locations. Verify redirect chains are single-hop where possible.

steps.title: Lower DNS TTL Before Cutover
steps.instructions: Reduce DNS TTL 24–48 hours before go-live so rollback is faster if issues appear after the switch.
